            de slob pa'i laM la 'ang de 2 tshogs pa <expan>med</expan> la | mi slob pa'i laM la 'ang de 2 tshogs pa myed pa'o || 
            kha yar ba mtshan nyid du 'god na ma khyab ste | spang pa la brtson pa'i dge' ba la phyin pa'i laM la ma khyab la bslab pa mthar phyin pa'i dge' ba tshogs laM laso pa 4 la ma khyab pas zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4242">rog</rs> laso pa <expan>zer ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
